sentences.en: That politician is well versed in internal and external conditions.
sentences.zh: 那位政客对内外部情况都很熟悉。

sentences.en: This lower-middle-income country remains vulnerable to natural and external shocks.
sentences.zh: 这个中低收入国家仍然容易受到自然和外部冲击的影响。

sentences.en: I can't believe you did all this without external help.
sentences.zh: 你竟然独自完成了这一切，我简直不敢相信。

senses.zh: 外部的，外面的；对外的，与外国有关的；外来的，外聘的；（药品等类似物质）外用的
